title: Display funeral prices
what: As a funeral director, prominently display the prescribed funeral information (including prices) at each place of business and on any public website.

sources.title: Fair Trading (Funeral Pricing) Regulation 2022 (Qld)
sources.quote: A funeral director must prominently display the funeral information in relation to the goods and services offered for supply by the funeral director— (a) at each place of business of the funeral director; and (b) on any public website maintained by the funeral director

administration.who: Chief executive of the department administering the Fair Trading Act 1989 (Qld)
